title: A Vaginal Microbiome Pharmacology Foundation Model for Microbiome-Based Drug Development and Reproductive Health Insights
summary: A deep-autoencoder vaginal microbiome pharmacology model produced drug–microbiome hypotheses, and the paper reports experimental testing of predicted taurine and hydroxyisocaproate effects. The claim is limited to the reported cell/pathogen assays.
ai_technology: Vaginal microbiome multiomics and autoencoder model; Methods describe training and synthetic-community assays. Results report cisplatin/taurine and metronidazole/hydroxyisocaproate predictions with follow-up assays. Baselines and scope remain those reported by the authors.
